powershell_script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false); $o=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $c=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor); [ordered]@{os=$o.Caption; build=$o.BuildNumber; cpu=@($c | ForEach-Object {$_.Name}); logical_cpus=($c | Measure-Object NumberOfLogicalProcessors -Sum).Sum; total_ram_bytes=[long]$o.TotalVisibleMemorySize*1024; available_ram_bytes=[long]$o.FreePhysicalMemory*1024; measured_at_utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')} | ConvertTo-Json
tool_version: not_probed; must capture before any authorized scientific run

host.os: Майкрософт Windows 10 Домашняя для одного языка
